newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee steady vs dlr, stable on NOC payments.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee steady vs dlr, stable on NOC payments.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened at 56.93-56.95 rupees per dollar on Wednesday, unchanged from Tuesday's close, dealers said.
The rates may remain at the same levels for some more time, as demand for dollars by the state owned Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC) to pay for petroleum product imports has ended for now, dealers said.
The payment was made without the central bank's intervention, dealers said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.

Inter-bank call money rates opened at 7.00-7.50 percent on Wednesday, a little lower compared to the previous close at 7.50 percent, dealers said. "There is excess liquidity in the market, which may push the call rate further down," they said.
